versions.changelog:
agent-create-config v1.0.0

- Initial release, merging "one-person-company" and "agentgener" skills.
- Provides a full 7-stage workflow for creating and launching new OpenClaw Agents.
- Covers end-to-end process: requirement gathering, config generation, workspace setup, registration, integration, validation, and confirmation.
- Emphasizes strict config file line limits and binding requirements.
- Designed so the CEO only coordinates; coding tasks are delegated.
